# ynab-mcp

> An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects an AI agent to a YNAB (You Need A Budget)
> account: budgets, accounts, categories, transactions (including splits), months, payees, and
> scheduled transactions. 46 tools across 8 toolsets. Published to npm as
> `@redlinelabs/ynab-mcp`, MIT licensed. Talks to the YNAB REST API (`https://api.ynab.com/v1`).

## Two ways to run it

- **stdio + Personal Access Token** — the five-minute solo quick start, via `npx`. One person, one
  YNAB account, no server to run.
- **Remote OAuth server** — self-hosted with Docker, for households or shared instances. Anyone who
  can reach it logs in with their own YNAB account and gets an isolated grant. Read-only by
  default; write access is an explicit scope elevation.

## Facts worth knowing before connecting an agent

- Every monetary amount in the YNAB API is in **milliunits**: 1000 = one currency unit.
- The YNAB API's rate limit is **200 requests/hour**.
- **Bank linking is impossible via the YNAB API** — that's YNAB-app-only. `create_account` makes
  manual accounts; `import_transactions` only refreshes accounts already linked in the YNAB app.
- The self-hosted server encrypts upstream YNAB refresh tokens at rest (AES-256-GCM) and stores its
  own issued tokens as hashes, never in the clear.
